content: The field cannot be well seen from within the field; you must climb the mountain to understand the valley.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Immersion in the details of a conflict often blinds us to its overall structure. Stepping back into quiet detachment grants the vantage point needed for clear vision.
practicalInsight: Elevate your perspective when stuck on a problem: view your situation from the viewpoint of ten years in the future.
reflectionPrompt: What immediate conflict looks trivial when viewed from a higher mountain of perspective?
